description: Personal Claude Code plugins living alongside the dotfiles they were extracted from.

plugins.name: agent-badge
plugins.description: Per-window tmux status badges showing what every Claude Code and Codex session in your tmux server is doing: working, finished, blocked on permission, or compacting.

plugins.description: /yank: pick a recent message and copy it into the tmux buffer (Claude Code mod).

plugins.name: viz
plugins.description: Skill for showing charts and diagrams through bin/viz (VS Code viewer).
